defensiveAbilities.name: Berserk
defensiveAbilities.description: A severely damaged charnel creation has a chance of going berserk. If it has 40 or fewer HP at the start of its turn, the creation must succeed at a DC 5 Flat or go berserk. A berserk creation wildly attacks the nearest living creature, or the nearest object if no creatures are nearby. A creation loses its immunity to mental effects while berserk.

defensiveAbilities.name: Electric Healing
defensiveAbilities.description: Any time a charnel creation would be affected by an effect with the electricity trait, it loses any Slowed condition it has and gains HP equal to half the damage the spell would have dealt. If the creation starts its turn in an area that deals electricity damage, it gains 2d4 Healing Damage{2d4 HP}.

defensiveAbilities.name: Electric Reflexes
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The creation would be affected by an effect with the electricity trait and a creature is in its reach

Effect The creation lashes out and tries to grab a nearby creature. The creation attempts an Athletics check to Grapple a creature within reach. The creature also takes 3d6 Electricity Damage damage on a success, or 6d6 Electricity Damage damage on a critical success.

offensiveAbilities.name: Berserk Slam
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The charnel creation is berserk

Effect The charnel creation Strikes with its fist at a –1 circumstance penalty. If it hits, it deals 1d6 extra damage and knocks the target Prone.
